description: Converts an imported raw-HTML landing page (import_landing_page_html) to section-based so side pages can be structured JSON. Keeps theme/nav/footer/domain; creates a new DRAFT version and regenerates hero/features/cta sections. The prior raw version stays restorable (restore_lp_version flips it back). The published version is NOT changed until you publish_landing_page. Returns an operationId — poll with get_job (or GET .../generate/status) until completed, review, then publish_landing_page. Also returns textSidePages ({slug, briefIds}): once the conversion job completes, re-run seo_generate_side_page (brief mode, existing briefIds) for each text side page — side-page generation reads the parent's DRAFT, so no publish is needed first. Publish the parent (publish_landing_page) for the side pages to appear in public exports / list_content_changes. Errors with 409 if the page is not raw HTML.

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Regenerates the page in this language; omit to keep the page's current language.

slug.description: Landing page slug (must be a raw-HTML page)

name: convert_landing_page_to_sections
